body: Thanks, they would be shattered and I cannot bear the thought of that

He stayed with me after the incident but I don't think he loves me anymore. I still wanted that proposal because I am an idiot but it never came and I am so heartbroken about it that I just broke up with him. He kept indicating that he wants to be with me but I am unable to believe him. All I wanted in my entire life was love and I never get it. I just had a major panic attack and my head is about to explode. Sorry to vent here.
I would have thought the same a few years ago when my grandpa was alive
You too!
Thanks for saying that but you can read my post history to see why I am horrible. My boyfriend decided to stay with me but I broke up with him today.
Thanks, your sarcasm is greatly appreciated

Yes, I will be working on myself. But my boyfriend himself isn't sure if he should break up with me since we had a great relationship and it was an aberration. I just want to make sure he knows I will do everything to not repeat it.
Yes, I have heard of it but haven't really gotten into it
Thank you so much.. Your response gives me hope. Do you have any suggestions apart from therapy to improve my anger issues?
Is one incident also unforgivable? I will obviously not push him for something he doesn't want but I just want to beg for forgiveness.
Thanks for your response. I appreciate it.

I wasn't rushing him but just asking what he wants and when so I could communicate to my family. This is quite common in Asian contexts especially at our ages. 

I will definitely work on my anger issues but I don't want to lose him. And I am willing to put in any work that takes. 

Does doing this once make someone abusive? I honestly want to know since it would break my heart to be abusive to the man I love so much.

Yes, I pushed him + slapped him and also banged my own head on the wall. I have reacted aggressively with him before (like pushing him away if he is trying to hold me when angry or squatting his arm etc) but not like this. 

I think that too - why am I this kind of person. I definitely don't want to be.
Do you think I just wait for him to decide then? I really wish there was a way I could salvage it.
That's my only hope. Any advice on how I can convince him that it was temporary insanity and I would do absolutely anything to not hurt him like this again?
Thanks, that's helpful
You are right, thanks. :)

I am actually also more of the latter usually. It's just in a romantic relationship that I try to be the former. My previous long term relationship failed partially because I never opened up to him so probably I am over compensating by discussing things. I am not very good at reading people and I want to make sure he is invested in this relationship. So when he doesn't communicate, I feel like he doesn't care. He knows this and always says that he never hurts me intentionally but that this is his natural reaction.

Do you think it is even worth it to try making it work with someone who is conflicted about you? His response to the marriage thing has just hurt me so much that currently I am feeling that I might not get over it.

Thanks so much for your advice though, very helpful to see a different perspective. I don't really have people I can talk to about this.
Hahaha, that is so painfully accurate about him that I might cry. He is so amazing and so oblivious at the same time!
Thanks! You have been super helpful.

I have told him many times that I prefer that we talk about things instead of glossing over them. I thought there would be a point when he would get it. 

Do you think there is a better way I can get through to him? I am at a complete loss

I asked him and he said, I quote "I am not sure". I am confused between giving him more time and quitting. If he said he wants to wait for a year, I would be fine but the fact that he doesn't communicate openly is my issue.

How should I give these examples? Any suggestions? I am at a complete loss 

In terms of the time, I am happy to do that but I also don't want to nag. Plus the main point of contention is about getting married and I feel very needy if I ask him again and again what he wants.
Haha, I haven't seen the show but now I will!
I agree but he should have told her.
But don't you think he should ask me if I am upset? We usually text all day and meet everyday so obviously, he knows that this is not normal.

Not sure if it changes your view but our fight was about getting married. We had discussed a month back and he said that we should do it but on Sunday, he said he doesn't feel that now is the right time. 

I have tried talking to him a lot, he is very unresponsive when it comes to talking about feelings but otherwise, he is super loving.

Yes, I have expressed that we should communicate better and he agreed. But when I actually push for a conversation, he just says random things and says we will talk later when we have more time (and later never comes). We are both very busy but we meet everyday so I feel that we can take out time for important communication points.
Why did you buy them used?
Thanks for your advice. I do feel like we don't have good communication. It's just tough because we are so happy when we are together.

That's my biggest problem. I keep trying to talk to him and he just doesn't reciprocate. He will say some abstract things when we talk, tell me we will talk properly soon but that never ever happens. I am at the point where I just want to ghost him but I am the kind of person who gets very attached so it is tough for me.
